links.outcome: Zero-shot LLM accuracy on diagnosis, ICD-9 coding, and readmission risk using discharge summaries
links.effect: ICD-9 correctness 14.6%-45.3%; readmission risk 33%-72.6%; diagnosis 79%-90%. None of the models met clinical standards across all tasks.
links.quote: None of the models met clinical standards across all tasks, and performance in medical coding remained the weakest area across all models.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks several zero-shot LLMs (including reasoning models) on clinical tasks using retrospective MIMIC-IV data, evaluating baseline model performance without testing specific deployment safeguards or organizational practices.
